business_problem: As the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, CBRE delivers a fully integrated suite of financial, property accounting, and fund administration services. Managing asset-level transactional processing and generating complex financial statements across a massive global portfolio requires immense operational precision.
solution_summary: CBRE is leveraging the Gemini platform with the help of McKinsey to rapidly build, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade AI agents. To continue improving service delivery for commercial property owners and managers, CBRE has been modernizing its facilities management technology stack. The company launched a multi-year digital initiative focused on improving operational efficiency, scaling its internal Ellis AI platform, and developing predictive maintenance capabilities. Moving beyond simple point-automation required a flexible framework designed to support AI-enabled workflows with appropriate oversight and controls. Traditional CRE operations involve a high level of manual interventions and rote document and information processing. We believe AI agents will alleviate these pain points, but a robust architecture is essential to enable successful deployment.
